const (
	EffectRead    Effect = "read"
	EffectWrite   Effect = "write"
	EffectNone    Effect = "none"
	EffectExecute Effect = "execute"
	EffectNetwork Effect = "network"
	EffectUnknown Effect = "unknown"
)

const (
	FailureStartup   FailureKind = "startup"
	FailureRateLimit FailureKind = "rate_limit"
	FailureAuth      FailureKind = "authentication"
	FailureProtocol  FailureKind = "protocol"
	FailureExecution FailureKind = "execution"
	FailureCancelled FailureKind = "cancelled"
)

const (
	InspectionUnsupported InspectionLevel = "unsupported"
	InspectionSummary     InspectionLevel = "summary"
	InspectionFull        InspectionLevel = "full"
)

const (
	PermissionEquivalent PermissionRelation = "equivalent"
	PermissionStricter   PermissionRelation = "stricter"
)

const (
	SessionStarted      Kind = "session_started"
	ExecutionActivity   Kind = "execution_activity"
	MessageDelta        Kind = "message_delta"
	Message             Kind = "message"
	ReasoningDelta      Kind = "reasoning_delta"
	ContentBlock        Kind = "content_block"
	ToolStart           Kind = "tool_start"
	ToolEnd             Kind = "tool_end"
	PermissionRequest   Kind = "permission_request"
	UserInputRequested  Kind = "user_input_requested"
	InteractionResolved Kind = "interaction_resolved"
	Error               Kind = "error"
	Completed           Kind = "completed"
)

const (
	Succeeded   Outcome = "completed"
	Failed      Outcome = "failed"
	Cancelled   Outcome = "cancelled"
	Interrupted Outcome = "interrupted"
	Waiting     Outcome = "waiting"
)

const (
	TodoPending    TodoStatus = "pending"
	TodoInProgress TodoStatus = "in_progress"
	TodoCompleted  TodoStatus = "completed"
)

const (
	ToolCommand  ToolKind = "command"
	ToolRead     ToolKind = "read"
	ToolEdit     ToolKind = "edit"
	ToolSearch   ToolKind = "search"
	ToolSubagent ToolKind = "subagent"
	ToolTodo     ToolKind = "todo"
	ToolOther    ToolKind = "other"
)

const (
	ToolDisplayBytes   = 4 << 10
	ToolDisplayResults = 10
	ToolDisplayTodos   = 30
)

const InspectionEnd = ^uint64(0)

func (d *ToolDisplay) Validate() error

func (d Descriptor) CanSatisfy(profile string) bool

func (d Descriptor) Clone() Descriptor

func (d Descriptor) Description(id string) Description

func (d Descriptor) Validate() error

func (r InteractionResolution) Validate(kind string) error

func (r UserInputRequest) Validate() error

func (r UserInputResponse) ValidateFor(request UserInputRequest) error

func (s *StreamContract) Accept(event Event) error

func (s StreamContract) Clone() StreamContract

func (u *Usage) Add(other Usage)

func (u Usage) Validate() error

func (v GenerationOptions) Clone() GenerationOptions

func (v GenerationOptions) Empty() bool

func (v GenerationOptions) Validate() error

func (w WaitCheckpoint) Validate() error

func BoundToolDisplay(display ToolDisplay) *ToolDisplay

func Checklist(content string) []TodoItem

func CloneInputFiles(files []InputFile) []InputFile

func CloneInputSkills(skills []InputSkill) []InputSkill

func CloneToolDisplay(display *ToolDisplay) *ToolDisplay

func DescribeRuntime(runtime Runtime) Descriptor

func LineChanges(old, updated string) (added, removed int)

func LineCount(text string) int

func MapToolDisplayStrings(display ToolDisplay, f func(string) string) ToolDisplay

func UnifiedDiff(diff string) (old, updated string, added, removed int)

func ValidateInputFiles(files []InputFile) error

func ValidateInputSkills(skills []InputSkill) error

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

import (
	"context"
	"time"
)

import (
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

import (
	"errors"
	"math"
)

import (
	"errors"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

type Activity struct {
	ID     string `json:"id"`
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	Effect Effect `json:"effect"`
}

type Capabilities struct {
	DurableWaits       bool `json:"durable_waits"`
	Streaming          bool `json:"streaming"`
	Resume             bool `json:"resume"`
	Cancel             bool `json:"cancel"`
	PermissionCallback bool `json:"permission_callback"`
	UserInputCallback  bool `json:"user_input_callback"`
	FileInputs         bool `json:"file_inputs"`
	SkillInputs        bool `json:"skill_inputs"`
	ToolControl        bool `json:"tool_control"`
}

type ConfigSurface struct {
	SupportsGeneration        bool   `json:"supports_generation"`
	SupportsMaxTurns          bool   `json:"supports_max_turns"`
	SupportsSystemPrompt      bool   `json:"supports_system_prompt"`
	ProviderProtocol          string `json:"provider_protocol"`
	SupportsFastMode          bool   `json:"supports_fast_mode"`
	SupportsCustomHTTPHeaders bool   `json:"supports_custom_http_headers"`
}

type Description struct {
	ID              string                 `json:"id"`
	Execution       Capabilities           `json:"execution"`
	Inspection      InspectionCapabilities `json:"inspection"`
	PermissionPlans []PermissionPlan       `json:"permission_plans"`
	Config          ConfigSurface          `json:"config"`
	Install         InstallMetadata        `json:"install"`
}

type Descriptor struct {
	Runtime         Runtime
	Inspector       Inspector
	PermissionPlans []PermissionPlan
	Config          ConfigSurface
	Install         InstallMetadata
}

type Effect string

type Event struct {
	Kind        Kind              `json:"kind"`
	SessionID   string            `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
	ID          string            `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Name        string            `json:"name,omitempty"`
	Text        string            `json:"text,omitempty"`
	Input       json.RawMessage   `json:"input,omitempty"`
	Reference   *Reference        `json:"reference,omitempty"`
	Effect      Effect            `json:"effect,omitempty"`
	IsError     bool              `json:"is_error,omitempty"`
	Recoverable bool              `json:"recoverable,omitempty"`
	Failure     FailureKind       `json:"failure,omitempty"`
	Outcome     Outcome           `json:"outcome,omitempty"`
	Usage       *Usage            `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	Activity    *Activity         `json:"activity,omitempty"`
	Wait        *WaitCheckpoint   `json:"wait,omitempty"`
	Question    *UserInputRequest `json:"question,omitempty"`

	Truncated bool `json:"truncated,omitempty"`

	Display *ToolDisplay `json:"display,omitempty"`

	Resolution *InteractionResolution `json:"resolution,omitempty"`
}

type FailureKind string

type GenerationOptions struct {
	Temperature     *float64 `json:"temperature,omitempty"`
	MaxTokens       *uint32  `json:"max_tokens,omitempty"`
	ReasoningEffort string   `json:"reasoning_effort,omitempty"`
}

type InputFile struct {
	ID         string `json:"id"`
	Name       string `json:"name"`
	URI        string `json:"uri"`
	Path       string `json:"path"`
	MediaType  string `json:"media_type"`
	SHA256     string `json:"sha256"`
	Bytes      int64  `json:"bytes"`
	TextURI    string `json:"text_uri,omitempty"`
	TextPath   string `json:"text_path,omitempty"`
	TextSHA256 string `json:"text_sha256,omitempty"`
	TextBytes  int64  `json:"text_bytes,omitempty"`
}

type InputSkill struct {
	Name   string `json:"name"`
	Path   string `json:"path"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
}

type InspectionBundle struct {
	Data       []byte            `json:"-"`
	RootID     string            `json:"root_id"`
	Sessions   int               `json:"sessions"`
	Records    int               `json:"records"`
	SHA256     string            `json:"sha256"`
	HighWaters map[string]uint64 `json:"high_waters"`
}

type InspectionCapabilities struct {
	Level             InspectionLevel `json:"level"`
	Historical        bool            `json:"historical"`
	Live              bool            `json:"live"`
	RawRecords        bool            `json:"raw_records"`
	RecursiveChildren bool            `json:"recursive_children"`
	ExportJSONL       bool            `json:"export_jsonl_bundle"`

	BackwardPages bool `json:"backward_pages"`
}

type InspectionChild struct {
	ParentID string                    `json:"parent_id"`
	ChildID  string                    `json:"child_id"`
	Link     InspectionRecordReference `json:"link"`
}

type InspectionEntry struct {
	ID            string                     `json:"id"`
	Sequence      uint64                     `json:"sequence"`
	Time          time.Time                  `json:"time"`
	Kind          string                     `json:"kind"`
	Namespace     string                     `json:"namespace"`
	Type          string                     `json:"type"`
	SchemaVersion uint32                     `json:"schema_version"`
	Parent        *InspectionRecordReference `json:"parent,omitempty"`
	Summary       string                     `json:"summary"`
	Value         InspectionReference        `json:"value"`

	RequestID string    `json:"request_id,omitempty"`
	RunID     string    `json:"run_id,omitempty"`
	CallID    string    `json:"call_id,omitempty"`
	Status    string    `json:"status,omitempty"`
	StartedAt time.Time `json:"started_at,omitzero"`
	EndedAt   time.Time `json:"ended_at,omitzero"`
}

type InspectionLevel string

type InspectionPage struct {
	Entries    []InspectionEntry `json:"entries"`
	Next       uint64            `json:"next"`
	HighWater  uint64            `json:"high_water"`
	HasMore    bool              `json:"has_more"`
	Before     uint64            `json:"before,omitempty"`
	HasEarlier bool              `json:"has_earlier,omitempty"`
}

type InspectionQuery struct {
	After, HighWater uint64
	Before           uint64
	Limit            int
	Literal          string
}

type InspectionRecordReference struct {
	SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
	RecordID  string `json:"record_id"`
	Sequence  uint64 `json:"sequence"`
}

type InspectionReference struct {
	URI        string `json:"uri"`
	MediaType  string `json:"media_type,omitempty"`
	SHA256     string `json:"sha256,omitempty"`
	Bytes      int64  `json:"bytes,omitempty"`
	Processing string `json:"processing,omitempty"`
}

type InspectionScope struct{ OwnerID, NativeID string }

type InspectionText struct {
	URI        string `json:"uri"`
	Text       string `json:"text"`
	Offset     int64  `json:"offset"`
	NextOffset int64  `json:"next_offset"`
	TotalBytes int64  `json:"total_bytes"`
	Truncated  bool   `json:"truncated"`
}

type Inspector interface {
	InspectionCapabilities() InspectionCapabilities
	Page(context.Context, InspectionScope, InspectionQuery) (InspectionPage, error)
	Read(context.Context, InspectionScope, string, int64) (InspectionText, error)
	Child(context.Context, InspectionScope, uint64) (InspectionChild, error)
	Observe(context.Context, InspectionScope, uint64, func(InspectionPage) error) error
	Export(context.Context, InspectionScope, uint64, bool) (InspectionBundle, error)
}

type InstallMetadata struct {
	RequiredBinary string `json:"required_binary,omitempty"`
	InstallHint    string `json:"install_hint,omitempty"`
}

type InteractionResolution struct {
	Allowed *bool               `json:"allowed,omitempty"`
	Answers map[string][]string `json:"answers,omitempty"`
}

type Kind string

type Outcome string

type PermissionDecision struct {
	Allow        bool
	UpdatedInput json.RawMessage
	Reason       string
}

type PermissionPlan struct {
	ProfileID string             `json:"profile_id"`
	Relation  PermissionRelation `json:"relation"`
	Summary   string             `json:"summary"`
}

type PermissionRelation string

type Reference struct {
	SessionID string `json:"session_id"`
	RecordID  string `json:"record_id,omitempty"`
	Sequence  uint64 `json:"sequence,omitempty"`
	URI       string `json:"uri,omitempty"`
}

type Request struct {
	OwnerID       string
	Prompt        string
	ResumeSession string

	WaitRevision  uint64
	Workspace     string
	Model         string
	Provider      string
	AccountSource string
	BillingRoute  string
	SystemPrompt  string
	MaxTurns      int
	Generation    GenerationOptions
	InputFiles    []InputFile
	InputSkills   []InputSkill

	ReportActivity func(Activity) error `json:"-"`

	RetainWorkspace func() (func(), error) `json:"-"`
}

type Runtime interface {
	Execute(context.Context, Request, func(Event) error) error
	Cancel(context.Context, string) error
	RespondPermission(context.Context, string, string, PermissionDecision) error
	Capabilities() Capabilities
}

type StreamContract struct {
	Started, Terminal, Fatal bool
	NativeSessionID          string
}

type TodoItem struct {
	Text   string     `json:"text"`
	Status TodoStatus `json:"status"`
}

type TodoStatus string

type ToolDiff struct {
	Old     string `json:"old,omitempty"`
	New     string `json:"new,omitempty"`
	Partial bool   `json:"partial,omitempty"`
}

type ToolDisplay struct {
	Kind ToolKind `json:"kind"`

	Command       string `json:"command,omitempty"`
	ExitCode      *int   `json:"exit_code,omitempty"`
	OutputInTrace bool   `json:"output_in_trace,omitempty"`

	Path string `json:"path,omitempty"`

	Files   int       `json:"files,omitempty"`
	Added   *int      `json:"added,omitempty"`
	Removed *int      `json:"removed,omitempty"`
	Diff    *ToolDiff `json:"diff,omitempty"`

	Query       string      `json:"query,omitempty"`
	Matches     *int        `json:"matches,omitempty"`
	MoreMatches bool        `json:"more_matches,omitempty"`
	Results     []ToolMatch `json:"results,omitempty"`

	Task           string `json:"task,omitempty"`
	ChildSessionID string `json:"child_session_id,omitempty"`
	Status         string `json:"status,omitempty"`

	Todos []TodoItem `json:"todos,omitempty"`
	Plan  string     `json:"plan,omitempty"`

	Output string `json:"output,omitempty"`
}

type ToolKind string

type ToolMatch struct {
	Path string `json:"path,omitempty"`
	Line int    `json:"line,omitempty"`
	Text string `json:"text,omitempty"`
}

type Usage struct {
	InputTokens           uint64  `json:"input_tokens"`
	OutputTokens          uint64  `json:"output_tokens"`
	CachedInputTokens     *uint64 `json:"cached_input_tokens,omitempty"`
	CacheWriteInputTokens *uint64 `json:"cache_write_input_tokens,omitempty"`
}

type UserInputOption struct {
	Label       string `json:"label"`
	Description string `json:"description,omitempty"`
}

type UserInputQuestion struct {
	ID       string            `json:"id"`
	Header   string            `json:"header"`
	Question string            `json:"question"`
	Options  []UserInputOption `json:"options,omitempty"`
	IsOther  bool              `json:"is_other,omitempty"`
	IsSecret bool              `json:"is_secret,omitempty"`
}

type UserInputRequest struct {
	Questions []UserInputQuestion `json:"questions"`
}

type UserInputResponder interface {
	RespondUserInput(context.Context, string, string, UserInputResponse) error
}

type UserInputResponse struct {
	Answers map[string][]string `json:"answers"`
}

type WaitCheckpoint struct {
	Revision  uint64 `json:"revision"`
	Requests  int    `json:"requests"`
	ExpiresAt int64  `json:"expires_at"`

	Calls []string `json:"calls,omitempty"`
}

type WaitingRunner interface{ WaitCheckpoint() *WaitCheckpoint }

var ErrSessionNotFound = errors.New("engine session not found")

var ErrUnsupported = errors.New("engine capability unsupported")
